verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate Granola can be started free, though only for a limited number of notes. The docs name paid Business and Enterprise plans, with workspace API keys gated to those tiers and HIPAA requiring a sales@ contact for Enterprise. Nothing in the pack shows published prices or a tier-by-tier feature comparison, so the transparency half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: first-party free-tier documentation, published per-tier prices, a feature comparison of what each tier adds, confirmation that self-serve paid upgrades need no sales contact.
